column1: # Hermit-cli test binaries that CI does not run, and their recorded disposition.
# This file cannot decide what exists. ci/audit-test-binary-registration.py
# derives the present set from `git ls-files`, so an unlisted binary is refused.
# A row here can only account for a binary the tracked tree proves exists.
# `none-recorded` IS AN HONEST UNKNOWN, NOT AN APPROVAL OR A PASS. Such rows
# preserve the ruling that no omission reason was recorded. They are reported in
# their own aggregate and excluded from both CI-covered and reason-recorded counts.
# Discharge a row by registering the binary in ci/dag/*.json and deleting it, or
# replace `none-recorded` with a concrete disposition and checkable reason.

column3: Cargo discovers this aarch64-only integration binary, but no CI DAG node runs it. Its physical tests are explicitly ignored and require the disk fixture root, supported launcher, C compiler, ptrace and real mapped-file proof documented in docs/TESTING_ENVIRONMENTS.md. An x86 binary with zero tests is not ARM execution coverage.

Its tests need a CentOS Stream 9 ld.so and libc.so.6 in the directory named by HERMIT_TEST_V2_ROOTFS (extraction documented in hermit-cli/tests/fixtures/x86-64-v2-rootfs/README.md). No Cargo validation node provisions them, so a registered run would only record HERMIT-TEST-SKIP lines. Meta's internal Buck target runs it with the fixture and HERMIT_TEST_REQUIRE_V2_ROOTFS=1, where a missing fixture fails instead of skipping. Discharge by provisioning the fixture in a validation node that sets HERMIT_TEST_REQUIRE_V2_ROOTFS=1, then registering the binary.

Measured 2026-10-14 on the validation host (nextest, third-party-backends): with a fixed epoch and the log in its own file (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4321), 5 of 6 tests pass; kvm_memory_hashes_repeat_for_a_static_guest cannot link its static guest (ld: cannot find -lc), neither on the host nor in the pinned root, which has no static glibc (https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4355).

Measured 2026-10-14 on hermit@44e22c71: passes on the validation host (nextest, third-party-backends) but fails in the pinned root that test.hermit_integration runs in (root, all capabilities, HERMIT_E2E_EMPTY_WORKDIR=/test): a test panics at hermit-cli/tests/sysfs_rtc_determinism.rs:30.

Measured 2026-11-17 on the exported tree of fbsource master with `cargo test --locked -p hermit-run --features liteinst --test unknown_syscall_refusal`: uprobe_gap_numbers_keep_their_native_outcome_under_ptrace passes, and unknown_syscall_numbers_receive_enosys_or_a_strict_refusal fails at hermit-cli/tests/unknown_syscall_refusal.rs:73, where the default run exits 122 after Detcore refuses "unsupported syscall: mseal". The test and tests/c/unknown_syscall_enosys.c take 462..470 to lie past Hermit's pinned syscall table, which ended at 461 under syscalls 0.7.0. Under syscalls 0.8.1 the table ends at 469 (detcore/src/syscall_classification.rs), so 462..469 are named, unsupported and refused, not unknown. Tracked in https://github.com/facebookexperimental/hermit/issues/380. Discharge by re-deriving the unknown numbers past the table's end, or by deciding the policy for 462..469, then registering the binary.
